surface: Supported AlchLang application source; existing pinned Core pure-source route
value_objects: Facts and manifests are immutable values, not independently identified Entities.
rules: VerifiedRead, DirectoryComplete and ChangesCovered are Boolean guards, not Policies.
policy: ReadEligibility chooses a typed diagnostic alternative; it is not a permission grant.
calculation: Choose constructs a pure enum result; it does not hide an effect.
operations: EnforceRead/Directory/Views/Evolution/Host/Coverage/ViewPublication enforce verified observed facts. PlanLifecycle returns a plan, not an admission.
coordination: The generated ordered LifecyclePlan is interpreted by shared Lab I/O ports and the existing durable JoinRun/native/publication owners. No Workflow meta type or business rule is replaced by an invented Adapter/Profile.
entities_and_events: Existing native artifact identities, JoinRun and signed journal/publication events remain the persistence owners; no duplicate record Entity is created.
instance: Real workspaces, stores, keys, owner decisions and destinations are explicit runtime inputs; no profile invents business facts or permission.
